name: Synthetic Data D2 (Agent Studio + SDS)
description: Agent Studio eval for the D2 synthetic-data workflow (4 agents; orchestrates Cloudera Synthetic Data Studio). Inputs map to the workflow variables target_tables, rows_per_table, database; expected_output describes the expected pipeline outcome (schema scan -> prompt build -> SDS generation in FK order -> SDS LLM-as-judge scorecard). Running the live workflow requires iceberg-mcp-server pointed at the Impala database AND the deployed SDS CAI app + synthetic_data_studio_tool. rows_per_table is kept at 25 (SDS synchronous demo cap). Set database to the actual Impala DB at eval time.
